changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.localization_value SET value = 'South Sudan National Public Health Laboratory', last_updated = NOW() WHERE localization_id = (SELECT id FROM clinlims.localization WHERE description = 'Site information banner test' LIMIT 1) AND value = 'Test LIMS';
